# Milestone Motion Productions

> Animation, 3D character sculpting and graphic design services by Devlin Wekesa Wepukhulu, based in Kenya, serving clients in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Dar es Salaam, Dodoma, Morogoro, Kampala and Kigali.

## Pages
- [Animation, 3D & Graphic Design in Kenya](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/): Animation, 3D character sculpting and graphic design services from Kenya. Serving Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Dar es Salaam, Kampala, Kigali and more.
- [About Devlin Wekesa Wepukhulu](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/about/): Meet Devlin Wekesa Wepukhulu, a motion and graphic designer with hands-on experience in 3D modeling, digital sculpting, rigging and animation.
- [3D Animation & Character Sculpting](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/3d-animation-character-sculpting/): 3D character modeling, digital sculpting, rigging and animation. See renders and a reel from Milestone Motion Productions. Clients across East Africa.
- [Animation & Motion Graphics Services](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/animation-motion-graphics/): Logo animation, social media videos, explainers and ads. See motion graphics made for FARAS Cabs by Milestone Motion Productions in Kenya.
- [FARAS Cabs Motion Graphics Videos](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/animation-motion-graphics/faras-cabs/): 18 animated videos made for FARAS Cabs: offers, customer support, FARAS Boda, corporate and Captains. A motion graphics case study.
- [Graphic Design Services in Kenya](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/): Brand identity, social media and campaign design, flyers, brochures, packaging and greeting cards for businesses, clients and organisations in Kenya.
- [Brands I Have Worked With](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/brands/): Brands, businesses and organisations Milestone Motion Productions has designed for, from transport and legal services to music, travel and food.
- [Contact Milestone Motion Productions](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/contact/): Contact Milestone Motion Productions on WhatsApp +254 742 099 793 or by email to start a design, animation or 3D project.
- [FARAS Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/faras-cabs/): A series of social media posts, a print flyer and campaign visuals for FARAS, a ride-hailing company in Kenya. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [M365Grow Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/m365grow-icons/): A four-icon set for M365Grow, taken from paper sketches to finished vector icons. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [Peres Odoyo & Co. Advocates Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/peres-odoyo-advocates/): A full brand kit for a Kisumu law firm and commissioner for oaths: logo, desk calendar, roll-up banners, embroidered polos and festive cards. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [Furaha Travel Agency Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/furaha-travel-agency/): A two-sided travel brochure that sells Kenyan safari and coast holidays. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [Seventh-day Adventist Church, Nyamasaria Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/sda-nyamasaria/): Event artwork for a church in Nyamasaria, Kisumu: a baby dedication banner and card, and Pathfinder induction Sabbath invitations. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [Ever Crave Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/ever-crave/): Packaging design for Ever Crave premium roasted cashew nuts, a 1000 g lightly salted pack, shown in five colour palettes. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [Drama Band Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/drama-band/): Posters and brand identity for Drama Band’s stage events in Nairobi. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [Meats By Adrian Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/meats-by-adrian/): A logo with packaging, a cap and an apron for a meat business. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
- [Smile Charities Graphic Design Case Study](https://milestonemotionproductions-ctrl.github.io/Milestone-Motion-Productions/graphic-design-services/smile-charities/): A donation flyer and a bright brand kit for a charity that helps homeless children: T-shirts, a hoodie and a branded van. A case study by Milestone Motion Productions.
